text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my morning started early. I wandered over to the cottage knoll and sat out in the cool dawn air, then took a swim in the pond to wake up. Nothing beats a fresh dip before the bees get busy. --wait

text: Um... hi. I'm Bo. This morning I walked over to the pond hall, then out to the orchard, and then back here again. It was quiet and the light was nice. I didn't play my music, I just listened. Thank you for listening to me.
